title: Text formatting in the properties pane
summary: Format selected text and callouts directly in the sidebar, expand Advanced controls, and dismiss New Image with its title close button.

Added: Selected text and callout objects expose bundled-font selection, font size and text color/opacity in the right properties pane.
An Advanced disclosure exposes horizontal and vertical alignment plus callout padding. Changes use the shared document history and renderer.
New Image has an accessible title close button that cancels the draft and preserves the existing document.
Improved: Properties headings and original preview icons follow the selected object. The object list follows its editable controls, and position fields can collapse.
Verified Copy All and New from Clipboard through their menus, including the flattened, unsaved result and exact native clipboard pixel comparisons.

limitations: Text content still uses a dialog. Two bundled fonts are supported; installed fonts, rich styles, text effects and exact reference layout remain incomplete.
The color picker can round channel values. Callouts have one rectangular body and triangular pointer; overall object opacity and additional styles remain planned.
Windows Save As/export dialog inspection remains blocked. Clipboard Save-and-continue, external clipboard compatibility and folder persistence need further verification.
This unsigned Windows x64 alpha does not yet include released screen capture, global hotkeys, library, video or full interface parity. Red version labels indicate unfinished broader scopes.
